fields.label: How has AI changed the way you approach your work?*
fields.name: question_35584681002
fields.ourAnswer: AI has significantly enhanced my engineering approach. I use AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development velocity and reduce boilerplate, allowing me to focus on architectural decisions and complex problem-solving. For team management, AI helps me analyze communication patterns and identify potential blockers early. In notifications specifically, AI enables smarter personalization engines and predictive timing optimization. However, I maintain critical evaluation—AI suggestions require human judgment, especially for user-facing features where precision matters. I've shifted from implementation details to higher-level strategy and mentorship, leveraging AI to amplify team productivity while preserving quality standards.
